title: First Family Visit
desc: Grandma, Grandpa, and the whole crew came to meet you. You slept through the entire thing like a true celebrity.
story: The house was full of flowers and people and love. You were passed from arm to arm and you slept through absolutely every single hug and kiss and introduction. Grandma cried. Grandpa pretended not to. Uncle James kept asking to hold you and then immediately handing you back. You were perfect through all of it.
